title: StudioDash Visual Walkthrough
seoTitle: StudioDash Screenshots & Visual Tour | BarkinMad Studios
description: Take a visual tour of StudioDash and see how its dashboard, app analytics, revenue reporting, integrations, website insights, and synchronisation tools work together.
summary: Explore StudioDash through screenshots that show how independent developers can monitor apps, revenue, websites, connected services, and business performance from one workspace.
heroImageAlt: StudioDash visual walkthrough showing developer analytics and business dashboards

featureShowcases.heading: Your Studio at a Glance
featureShowcases.summary: Start with a clear overview of your apps, revenue, and connected services.
body: The StudioDash dashboard is designed to give you a useful starting point for checking your studio. Instead of opening several different services, you can begin with one view of your portfolio and then move into the areas that need more attention.
Revenue, app information, provider health, and other supported data sit together so a quick daily check can provide more context than looking at individual dashboards in isolation.

image.alt: StudioDash dashboard showing app portfolio, revenue and connected services
image.caption: Start with one view of your apps and studio.

featureShowcases.heading: Monitor Your Apps & Connected Services
featureShowcases.summary: See how your app portfolio is performing and whether connected services need attention.
body: StudioDash brings supported App Store information and connected service status into the same workspace. This makes it easier to understand what is happening across several apps without checking each product individually.
Provider health information also helps distinguish a genuine connection problem from a service that simply has no new information available.
bullets: Downloads, sales, ratings and reviews where available.

image.alt: StudioDash app portfolio and connected service analytics
image.caption: Monitor your apps and the services behind them from one workspace.

featureShowcases.heading: Understand the Business Behind Your Apps
featureShowcases.summary: See where revenue comes from, how it changes over time, and which apps or sources contribute to your results.
body: StudioDash Revenue Analytics brings supported App Store, advertising, and other revenue information into one reporting experience. This gives you a clearer view of commercial performance when income is spread across several services.

Explore revenue over different periods and investigate supported breakdowns by app, source, country, and date. Business goals can add further context by showing how your results compare with the targets you have set for your studio.
bullets: Revenue by app and provider where available.
Country and date breakdowns where supported.

image.alt: StudioDash revenue analytics showing revenue sources and historical trends
image.caption: Understand how revenue changes across your apps and studio.

featureShowcases.heading: Include Your Website in the Picture
featureShowcases.summary: Monitor supported website analytics, search performance, connected services, and synchronisation alongside your apps.
body: StudioDash extends beyond App Store reporting by bringing supported website, analytics, and search information into the same workspace as your app portfolio.
This allows website activity and search visibility to become part of your wider studio reporting rather than remaining isolated in separate services.

image.alt: StudioDash website, search and provider analytics
image.caption: Keep website and search performance alongside your app portfolio.

sections.heading: Take a Tour of StudioDash
paragraphs: These screenshots provide a visual introduction to the main StudioDash experience, from the portfolio dashboard through app analytics, revenue reporting, websites, and connected services.
StudioDash is designed so each area builds on the same underlying picture of your studio. Start with the overview, then move into more detailed reporting when something deserves a closer look.

sections.heading: Screenshots Will Evolve with StudioDash
paragraphs: StudioDash is still being refined ahead of its wider release, so some screens may change as the interface, reporting, and plan experiences are improved.
The screenshots on this page will be updated as major visual changes reach the product so the walkthrough continues to represent the current StudioDash experience.
